run_main_convert_icot_to_json: run the main function to convert GSM ICOT text data to JSON format for a given split
build_gsm_dataset_json: build a JSON dataset from GSM ICOT text files by parsing questions steps and answers
create_gsm_split_json: create a JSON file from a GSM text split like train test or valid
test_main_function: test the main function by passing a split name to convert text data to JSON
refactor_main_parsing: refactor the main function to support additional delimiters or output formats for GSM data
